name: Offenses
overview: Scripture reveals that offenses among believers are serious matters that require careful handling, as a brother offended is difficult to reconcile, likened to a strong city (Proverbs 18:19). The Lord hates certain sins that cause offense (Proverbs 6:16), yet Christ calls His followers to respond to wrongs with grace and forgiveness, instructing them to turn the other cheek (Matthew 5:39) and to seek reconciliation privately to restore relationships (Matthew 18:15). Forgiveness is to be extended repeatedly, reflecting Christ’s mercy (Matthew 18:21), and believers are commanded to bless and pray even for those who mistreat them (Luke 6:28).
